title: Palm Oil & Power: Women in an Era of Economic and Social Transition in 19th Century Yorubaland
lineage: Historical PhD dissertation quoting Robert Campbell and Samuel Johnson; the primary accounts were not independently inspected.

passages.note: Shields reports Campbell described Egba esusu clubs chiefly formed by women in 1860; Johnson describes regular contributions distributed to members in rotation in the late 19th century.

file.method: Paraphrased notes of the passages inspected.
